title: Helix Ransomware Group: Victims, Leak Site, TTPs & IOCs
description: Helix is a financially motivated cybercrime group that emerged in July 2026, specializing in data extortion through sophisticated identity theft techniques. The group combines voice phishing with Microsoft OAuth Device Code Flow abuse to bypass multi-factor authentication and compromise enterprise environments. They target high-value Microsoft 365 cloud infrastructures, specifically SharePoint data repositories, primarily in North America. Using two compromised accounts, Helix conducts stealthy data theft through automated scripts and shared cloud infrastructure, exfiltrating sensitive information without deploying custom malware. Extortion demands are delivered through corporate collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and email. Their operations demonstrate advanced social engineering capabilities combined with cloud service abuse for large-scale data theft and extortion.
